difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y flat and locally of finite presentation between spaces over S, the full subcategory of D(O_X) of Y-perfect objects is saturated triangulated (the footnote pins saturated to the Derived Categories definition). The retained proof is written as a four-lemma import: Y-perfectness means relative pseudo-coherence plus finite tor dimension; the two Closure axioms for a triangulated subcategory (direct summands, shifts/triangles) and the two saturation axioms are respectively Derived Categories of Schemes... the cited Cohomology on Sites lemmas cone-pseudo-coherent, summands-pseudo-coherent, cone-tor-amplitude, summands-tor-amplitude — the four closure theorems for the two ingredients under cones and summands; assembling the definitions gives saturated triangulated immediately. Retained author proof at lines 12375-12381.
